detail.longDescription:
Skales is an AI agent that does the work, not just the talking. Give it a job and it plans the steps, uses real tools - calendar, tasks, web, files, contacts - and delivers a finished result, asking your permission before anything happens. It runs on the AI of your choice, pairs with your computer, and keeps everything it knows about you on your device.

WHAT AN AGENT DOES THAT A CHATBOT CANNOT

- "Plan my Friday" becomes a structured schedule in your real calendar.
- "Research this and write me a briefing" becomes cited sources and a document.
- "Open a ticket and tell me what they answer" becomes an API call, made with your approval, with the reply shown to you.
- Multi-step work runs through: the agent chains tools, shows every step, and finishes - it does not stop at a wall of text.

EVERY MAJOR AI, ONE APP

Start free with Skales IQ - just your email, no API key, no card. Or bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek and OpenRouter. Chat with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral or DeepSeek, pick the reasoning depth per conversation, and switch models anytime without losing your session.

AUTOMATION WITH A HARNESS

Skales is built as an agent harness: tools, memory, skills and permissions working together. A curated skill library ships with the app - from disciplined bug diagnosis to research with cited sources - and the agent reaches for the right skill on its own. Every action that touches the outside world asks first. Every capability can be switched off.

MEMORY THAT GROWS

Teach Skales what matters. It remembers context across conversations and adapts to you - stored on your device, fully under your control, with three levels from full memory to none.

AI STUDIO AND VOICE

Generate images and video, design social posts and quote cards from ready templates, and share them to the community feed. Talk to Skales and hear it answer with natural text-to-speech.

YOUR COMPUTER, FROM YOUR POCKET

Pair with the free Skales desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux and reach your computer's AI, sessions, files and tools from your phone. Or control the phone from any browser on your network through the built-in web interface.

PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE, NOT BY PROMISE

Your chats and memory stay on your device by default. With your own key, requests go straight from your phone to the provider you chose - Skales runs no servers in between. No advertising IDs, no third-party analytics, no data sold. Ever. Optional online features are clearly marked and off by default.

And when you want zero cloud: Skales Local (beta) downloads an openly licensed model that answers directly on the device - no key, no connection, even in airplane mode. Or connect your own Ollama server on your WiFi and chats never leave your network.

BUILT FOR EVERYONE

From homework to client work to a first email - useful without being intimidating. No Docker, no terminal, no setup, no subscription. 12 languages.

FREE KEYS TO START (BYOK)

OpenRouter (free starter credit), Google AI Studio (generous free tier), Groq (fast free tier).

OPEN BY DESIGN

Source-available under BSL 1.1: inspect the code, verify what it does, trust what runs on your device.

Questions or bugs: request@skales.app - more at skales.app. Skales Mobile is part of one ecosystem with Skales Desktop for Windows, macOS and Linux.
